notes: Copper (RJ-45) SFP module over Category 5 UTP; not an optical transceiver. LP-SFP-TMRC ordering variant: 0~70°C commercial case; industrial SKUs -40~85°C per Environmental Specifications and ordering table. Features state 1.05 W typical power; Table 1 notes 1.2 W max over full voltage and temperature and that power consumption and surge current exceed SFP MSA limits. Data rate Table 5: 10 to 1,000 Mb/sec (comma as thousands separator). Cable reach 100 m Category 5 UTP at BER <10^-12; ordering lists Transmission Distance 0.1 Km. Symbol rate 250 Mbps on each of four pairs. Line frequency 125 MHz (5-level encoding per IEEE 802.3). Clock tolerance +/- 50 ppm. Host LP-SFP-TMRC uses SGMII; other orderable parts use SERDES. RJ-45 front connector; mechanical per SFP MSA with enlarged front for RJ-45.
suggestions: Add copper/RJ45 media fields (cable category, max cable length m, RJ-45 connector) and SFP to form_factor enum. Map post_fec_ber_target only if BER is explicitly tied to FEC; here BER <10^-12 is a cable-length condition in Table 5. Consider separate temp_min_c/temp_max_c per commercial vs industrial SKU when model list spans both.
